title: Embattle
summary: EMBAT'TLE, verb transitive [en and battle.] To arrange in order of battle; to array troops for battle. On their embattled ranks the waves return. 1. To furnish with battlements. EMBAT'TLE, verb intran

inlines.v: EMBAT'TLE, verb transitive [en and battle.] To arrange in order of battle; to array troops for battle. On their embattled ranks the waves return. 1. To furnish with battlements. EMBAT'TLE, verb intransitive To be ranged in order of battle.
